blind.B1: Yes. 12-week cycle ergometry in DM1 patients; DM1-PRE and DM1-POST biopsies (11 each) carry the exercise factor. Healthy CON (n=10) are sedentary, one biopsy, not an exercise arm (S2.8-S2.9, S4.16, Fig 4).
blind.B2: DM1-POST vs DM1-PRE (n=11 vs 11, paired; paper 1 down/18 up, S2.9.p1, Fig 4C). DM1-PRE vs CON (n=11 vs 10; paper 205 down/435 up, S2.8.p1, Fig 4B).
blind.B3: Yes. Each DM1 patient is biopsied pre and post. Candidate key: subject (Sample_N), which appears once in each treatment level and links 22/32 samples. Control_N are different people.
blind.B4: S4.16.p1: DESeq2 'taking into account the group and paired sample study design'. The paper does not say whether one model held all samples or each pair of groups was fitted alone.
blind.B5: Fig 4 legend: significant = |log2(FC)| > 1.5 and P < 0.005 (raw P, strict inequalities, no FDR). Counts: PRE vs CON 205 down/435 up; POST vs PRE 1 down/18 up.

checks.evidence: Series has a genuine pre/post training arm in DM1 patients; analyzed. PRE vs CON is labelled associational/disease, not exercise.
grp from titles gives CON 10, PRE 11, POST 11, matching paper n=10-11. The missing control for patient 5 is recorded as a discrepancy. Control is PRE for the exercise contrast.
POST vs PRE (control PRE, treatment POST) and PRE vs CON (control CON), as the paper reports them.
POST vs PRE fitted as ~ subject + grp on 11 complete pairs; Control_N kept separate from Sample_N; subject is categorical.
Paper silent on joint vs pairwise fit; the case fits each contrast on its own subset and states this in method.deviations, with the reason (a joint model with subject cannot estimate CON vs PRE).
Extraction batches (P6 pilot, per-group batches, S4.16.p1) may align with group. Recorded as a caveat in covariance and study; no batch column is deposited.
HTSeq integer counts (integer_fraction 1.0) into DESeq2, the paper's route. The p-value histogram is sane (frac_p_gt_0.9 0.301 and 0.077).
Applied rule is raw pvalue < 0.005 and |log2FC| > 1.5, non-inclusive, as in the Fig 4 legend. A padj < 0.05 audit rule is reported alongside.

Same contrasts compared. Ours is 55 vs paper 19 and 1471 vs 640, and the excess is attributed to low-count genes and checked with filtered runs (27 and 664). The filtered runs are labelled sensitivity, and the paper's DEG lists were unavailable.

human_items: Open policy question: the stated rule gives 55 and 1471 DEGs against the paper's 19 and 640, while a mean-count>=10 filter (iDEP default) gets close, especially for PRE vs CON (664). Which one to report as the headline is not settled; the case reports the paper's stated rule and keeps the filtered run as a sensitivity analysis.
summary: 该案例通过。外源性运动对比为 DM1 患者 POST vs PRE，按患者配对（~ subject + grp），阈值严格按图4图例（原始 P<0.005 且 |log2FC|>1.5）。对照、方向、分批提取混杂与未指定的模型拟合方式均已记录；与论文计数的差异（55 vs 19，1471 vs 640）已用低表达过滤的敏感性分析说明。
